description: Plan de voirie - Repère de nivellement is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Repère de nivellement - Station de polygonale - Point de canevas topographique - Altimétrie du repère de nivellement - Système orthométrique (mm) et altitude au sol en (cm). Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are PVP, Altimétrie, NGF, DVD. The portal shows 9,811 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
